description: This file defines the RouteCollectorInterface interface for the Slim Framework, specifying methods for managing routes, route parsing, caching, and invocation strategies.

methods.name: getRouteParser
methods.description: Returns the RouteParserInterface used for parsing route definitions.

methods.name: getDefaultInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Returns the current InvocationStrategyInterface used as the default for route invocation.

methods.name: setDefaultInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Sets the default invocation strategy for routes. Accepts an InvocationStrategyInterface object.

methods.name: getCacheFile
methods.description: Retrieves the path to the FastRoute cache file, if set.

methods.name: setCacheFile
methods.description: Sets the file path for FastRoute cache. May throw InvalidArgumentException or RuntimeException.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Returns the base path used in route URL generation.

methods.name: setBasePath
methods.description: Sets the base path for route URL generation.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Returns an array of RouteInterface objects representing all routes.

methods.name: getNamedRoute
methods.description: Retrieves a route by its name. Throws RuntimeException if not found.

methods.name: removeNamedRoute
methods.description: Removes a route by its name. Throws RuntimeException if not found.

methods.name: lookupRoute
methods.description: Finds a route by its unique identifier. Throws RuntimeException if not found.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Adds a group of routes with a common pattern. Accepts a string pattern and a callable or route group.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Adds a new route with specified HTTP methods, pattern, and handler.
